summary.text: Curtis James is the Democratic candidate for Idaho House of Representatives District 12B in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Jaron Crane.
James works as a social worker, according to Ballotpedia, and said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a fourth-generation Idahoan and an online undergraduate student.

paragraphs.text: James earned a high school diploma from Columbia High School and lists a career as a social worker.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a fourth-generation Idahoan from a family of mechanics, medical professionals and construction tradespeople, that he works at a Dutch Bros window in Nampa, and that he is studying Religious Studies online at LSUA.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

James said his campaign priorities include protecting funding for Career and Technical Education and special education, local control of decisions, and infrastructure in which new development pays its fair share.
